title: How to add a prefix or suffix to a cell
task: Bolt fixed text onto values — ID- codes, units, currency labels, domain suffixes.
keywords: add text to beginning of cell

excel.note: & joins text. To add without a formula, use a custom format like "ID-"@ (keeps the value editable).

explanation: Wrap the literal text in quotes and join it with & on either side of the cell: "ID-" before and "-US" after turns 4092 into ID-4092-US. The result is text, so it won't sum or sort numerically — if you only need the look and want to keep the number usable, apply a custom cell format ("ID-"0"-US") instead, which prepends/appends on display while leaving the real value intact. For many cells, TEXTJOIN or a fill-down copies the same pattern down the column.
